complete_resulting_semantic_state.label: Durable Ontology Epoch Reconciliation
complete_resulting_semantic_state.definition_or_claim: A stale registration can remain fail-closed and still yield one bounded, durable, reviewable candidate epoch without rewriting admitted bytes or inferring promotion.
complete_resulting_semantic_state.scope: Product capability design selected by the owner; system realization, provider binding, recovery proof, and admission remain separate.

forbidden_collapse.context: A durable candidate epoch is not current registration, semantic repair, admission, promotion, or activation.
